# Refactor & API Contract Checklist: Refactor Modules for Cleaner and Optimized Code

**Purpose**: Validate that requirements for refactor scope, API immutability, and code quality are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable (requirements quality—not implementation verification).  
**Created**: 2026-03-08  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not whether the implementation works.

---

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all in-scope endpoints explicitly identified (e.g. by module and route file or prefix) so implementers know exactly which responses must remain unchanged? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK002 Is "exactly the same API response" defined with sufficient precision—body, status code, and "relevant headers"—so there is no ambiguity about what must be preserved? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK003 Are error response preservation requirements specified for all error types (validation, not-found, unauthorized) mentioned in the spec? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK004 Is the verification method for unchanged behavior (existing tests, manual test cases, contract checks) clearly specified so failures can be treated as defects? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK005 Are side-effect preservation requirements (database state, queues, notifications) explicitly stated so refactor does not change observable outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK006 Is the boundary for "direct dependencies that affect only these modules" (FR-007) defined or exemplified so shared code changes can be judged in or out of scope? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "relevant headers" in the API response contract defined or scoped so implementers know which headers must stay identical? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK008 Are "separation of concerns," "reduced duplication," and "consistent patterns" specified or exemplified enough to be reviewable without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK009 Is "same or fewer data access operations" (FR-006) defined in a way that can be measured (e.g. query count per request)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK010 Are "representative requests" or "defined set of representative requests" (SC-004) specified or left to implementation; and if the latter, is that assumption documented? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do requirements for error response preservation (FR-002) align with edge case wording on "error messages and validation messages" so there is no conflict? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Are "no new public API surface" (FR-003) and "identical API response" (FR-001) stated consistently across spec and plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK013 Do performance requirements (FR-006, SC-004) align with constitution performance targets (e.g. ≤500ms p95) so refactor success criteria are consistent? [Consistency, Plan Constitution Check]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Can "byte-identical or schema-identical responses" (SC-001) be verified in practice; and is the choice of byte vs schema documented or left to implementation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK015 Is "improved structure as agreed in code review" (SC-003) defined with enough criteria that reviewers can consistently agree what counts as improved? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK016 Are success criteria free of implementation detail (e.g. no mandatory technology-specific metrics) while remaining measurable? [Acceptance Criteria Quality, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are primary flows (normal request/response for read and write) covered by acceptance scenarios or success criteria? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1–3]
- [x] CHK018 Are alternate flows (e.g. optional parameters, multiple valid response shapes) explicitly addressed in requirements? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Are exception flows (validation failure, not-found, unauthorized) required to preserve format and status, and is that stated in requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, Acceptance Scenarios]
- [x] CHK020 Are recovery or rollback scenarios (e.g. deployment rollback if refactor causes regression) addressed or explicitly out of scope? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are optional parameters and multiple valid response shapes explicitly in scope for "preserve all existing shapes and status codes"? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 Is behavior when refactor touches shared code used by other modules specified (only Expense, Shift, Purchase behavior in scope; no change to other modules)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Are database transaction and side-effect ordering requirements stated so commit/rollback and ordering remain identical? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK024 Is the case of "no existing tests" or partial test coverage for an endpoint addressed (e.g. manual verification, snapshot, or documented risk)? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK025 Are performance non-functional requirements (response time, resource usage) stated in measurable terms and aligned with success criteria? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-006, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK026 Is maintainability (code structure, readability) specified in a way that can be assessed (e.g. code review criteria or structural guidelines)? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-003, §SC-003]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK027 Are assumptions (existing API responses as source of truth, existence of tests or manual procedures) documented and traceable so they can be validated before refactor? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK028 Is the assumption that "optimization" means clearer code and better performance without changing business rules or API contracts explicitly stated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK029 Are dependencies on existing tests or contract checks documented so missing coverage can be identified? [Dependency, Spec §FR-005]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK030 Is there any conflict between "improve code structure" and "do not change any response" that could lead to different interpretations (e.g. changing response keys for "consistency")? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-001]
- [x] CHK031 Is "representative set of read and write operations" (User Story 3) or "defined set of representative requests" (SC-004) clarified so that performance verification is repeatable? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add comments or findings inline; link to spec sections (e.g. `[Spec §FR-001]`) where relevant
- Items are numbered sequentially for reference
- This checklist validates **requirements quality** (completeness, clarity, consistency, coverage, measurability), not implementation behavior
